title: 국립공원공단법 시행령 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Registration of Appointment of Agent, etc.)
(1) Where the chairperson of the Service appoints an agent pursuant to Article 6 of the Act, the Service shall, within two weeks after the appointment, register the following matters at the location of its principal office: <Amended on January 21, 2025>
1. Name and address of the agent;
2. Name and location of the principal office or subordinate organization for which the agent is appointed;
3. Details of any restriction on the agent's authority.
(2) Where any matter under paragraph (1) changes, the chairperson of the Service shall register the change within two weeks after such change.
(3) Where the chairperson dismisses an agent appointed pursuant to Article 6 of the Act, the Service shall, within two weeks after the dismissal, register the fact of dismissal at the location of its principal office. <Amended on January 21, 2025>
